Measurement-uncompute the apply-phase modular subtract's raw difference.

Building on the current best (DIALOG_GCD_WIDTH_MARGIN + measured comparator via cmp_lt_into_fast + measured subtrahend-clear), the apply SUB (dialog_gcd_cmod_sub_materialized_pseudomersenne) was still computing its raw difference with the NON-fast cuccaro_sub (sub_nbit_qq), i.e. an explicit inv_maj/inv_uma Toffoli uncompute sweep (~2n CCX), while the symmetric apply ADD already uses the measured cuccaro_add_fast (~n CCX). Switched the raw difference to cuccaro_sub_fast (Gidney hmr/cz_if measurement uncompute, gated by DIALOG_GCD_MEASURED_APPLY_SUB).
